description: Poki uses your iPhone like you do. An open-source agent app that runs on your iPhone, reads the screen, and taps, types and swipes in real apps with your own model account.
vibe: Deterministic task runners, disciplined formatting, and modular consistency.
highlights: To install or update the Poki app on the user's iPhone (the standalone app with Poki Setup), follow the skill [skills/install-poki/SKILL.md](skills/install-poki/SKILL.md) instead. That skill has separate first-install and update branches, including checks for preserving the existing signing identity and data. This file installs Poki MCP for an MCP client.

MCP only.** If the user already uses Claude Code, Codex, or another MCP client and only asks to install this repository, connect Poki MCP to that client. Use the user's existing subscription and model. No extra model account or Poki login is needed. Follow steps 1–5 and the MCP checks in step 7, then end the installation. Skip step 6, including model login and the optional unlock question.
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
